_comment: KeyMapr config — copy to ~/.config/keymaprd/config.json and edit. Run 'keymaprd --dump' to find your button numbers.

_buttons.btn3: first extra button (thumb back on MX Master)
_buttons.btn4: second extra button (thumb forward on MX Master)
_buttons.btn5+: additional extra buttons — use --dump to discover

_supported_keys.letters: a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z
_supported_keys.special: space  return  tab  escape  delete  backspace
_supported_keys.function: f1 f2 f3 f4 f5 f6 f7 f8 f9 f10 f11 f12

_named_actions.mission_control: opens Mission Control (mapped to F3 by default)
_named_actions.launchpad: opens Launchpad      (mapped to F4 by default)
